title: Mingongo Pembeni Ya Mai Ya Kisi
intro: Kanisá lisangá moko oyo ezwaki nkombo mpo na engumba to mokonzi moko te, kasi mpo na mai ya kimya oyo bomoi esanganaki zingazinga na yango. Kaka mwa bavɛrsɛ moke nde bamikundoli lisangá oyo, ntango nyonso etángamaki kati na baoyo baboyaki litambwisi. Yoka ntango bazali koloba uta na molili.
clues: Tozali lisanga oyo ezwami na nkombo na Coran, nzokande lisolo na biso mobimba etikali ezipami na libombami.
Tolobelamaka ntango nyonso pembeni ya baoyo bawanganaki, lokola bato ya Ad mpe ya Thamud.
Tobengami Baninga ya Ar-Rass, Libulu oyo bomoi na biso ekangamaki na yango.
Towanganaki momemi-nsango oyo batindelaki biso na litambwisi ya polele.
Totangami na kati ya baye baboyaki bamemi-nsango banso oyo Allah atindaki.
Tokutanaki na likama oyo ekokisamaki na mowangani nyonso liboso na biso, kobebisama mpo na koboya na biso.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
